# Code of conduct

This program is developed by Zorost Intelligence AI Lab and published for
public learning. We expect the same standard we use on client work: be
precise, be civil, and do not waste other people's time.

## Expected

- Ask questions with the module path, what you ran, and the full traceback.
- Assume good intent. Correct facts, not people.
- Keep examples free of harassment, sexual content involving minors, and
  instructions for crime or unauthorized access.
- Do not paste secrets, API keys, personal data, or private client material
  into issues, discussions, or pull requests.

## Not tolerated

- Harassment, hate, or threats.
- Doxxing or publishing private information.
- Spam, off-topic promotion, or model-weight dumps that violate a license.
- Jailbreak recipes, exploit PoCs, or malware.

## Enforcement

Report conduct issues to **info@zorost.com**. Maintainers may edit or close
threads, and may block accounts that repeat the behavior.

This document follows the spirit of the Contributor Covenant 2.1 without
copying its text.
